title: Agent Framework + Foundry
description: Learn Microsoft Agent Framework and Foundry by writing the code for a working multi-agent application.

chapters.title: Get ready and try the interview coach
chapters.description: Set up your tools, run the finished app, and try a short interview.

chapters.title: Start your workshop app
chapters.description: Open your own working folder and run the supplied application shell.

chapters.title: Ask your first agent a question
chapters.description: Create a ChatClientAgent, give it instructions, and get a reply.

chapters.title: Put the coach in the chat UI
chapters.description: Wire the agent into the supplied Blazor app and stream its replies.

chapters.title: Give the coach a C# tool
chapters.description: Write a function, expose it as a tool, and inspect a real invocation.

chapters.title: Expose interview tools with MCP
chapters.description: Start InterviewData and discover the tools its server provides.

chapters.title: Connect the coach to those tools
chapters.description: Let the coach create and fetch a synthetic interview record.

chapters.title: Save interview progress
chapters.description: Give the agent a session lifecycle and inspect the records it saves.

chapters.title: Read a resume with a tool
chapters.description: Connect MarkItDown and inspect the text extracted from a sample resume.

chapters.title: Use the resume in the interview
chapters.description: Connect document extraction and use a resume and job description as context.

chapters.title: Make your first handoff
chapters.description: Watch triage transfer document intake to the receptionist.

chapters.title: Add the interviewers
chapters.description: Connect behavioural and technical practice using the saved interview context.

chapters.title: Finish with a summary agent
chapters.description: Complete the five-role workflow and save its final feedback.

chapters.title: Run your completed interview
chapters.description: Complete an interview and check the tool calls, transitions, and saved summary.

chapters.title: Find and fix a failed step
chapters.description: Trace a failed document request and follow an early-finish handoff.
